hook.text: Snowflake went public in 2020 at a $33 billion valuation. A data warehouse company. How?

buildup.text: Snowflake's insight: separate storage, compute, and services into three independent, scalable layers.

discovery.text: Users can spin up multiple isolated compute warehouses against the same data — no contention, no sharing.

twist.text: Snowflake runs on top of AWS, Azure, and GCP. It's a cloud service built on other cloud services.

climax.text: Snowflake proved that simplicity, performance, and a great user experience could disrupt the warehouse market.

punchline.text: Simple to use. Hard to leave. That's the Snowflake formula.

quiz.question: What architectural insight made Snowflake successful?
options: Separating storage, compute, and services into independent layers
